items.titleZh: 全身炎症作为慢性下腰痛运动益处的介质：深化机制视角
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了全身炎症在慢性下腰痛运动益处中的介导作用，旨在深化运动疗法的机制理解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Systemic inflammation is a key mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain. Understanding this mechanism can help you design more precise exercise protocols to maximize anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the perspectives of 14 international patients with rotator cuff tendinopathy, identifying 33 subthemes across three main themes regarding their experiences and management priorities, including clarity on symptom onset and treatment outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究提供了肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的直接看法。它强调了患者在治疗中对明确诊断和治疗结果的重视，以及对倾听和验证感受的临床医生的需求，有助于改善医患沟通。
items.titleZh: “我现在真的只相信运动了”：肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了14名国际肩袖肌腱病患者对治疗管理的看法，识别了围绕症状发作清晰度、治疗结果及倾听型临床医生等优先事项的3个主题下33个子主题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study offers direct patient perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management. It highlights patients' prioritization of clear diagnoses and treatment outcomes, alongside valuing clinicians who listen and validate their experiences, which can improve patient-clinician communication.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小（14人）且为国际线上访谈，结果可能不具普遍代表性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample (14 participants) and international online interviews, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Development and Content Validation of an Exercise-Based Framework for the Management of Lumbar Radiculopathy.
items.summary: This study focused on the development and content validation of an exercise-based framework for lumbar radiculopathy, aiming to integrate various evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise.
items.curatedReason: 本研究开发并验证了腰椎神经根病基于运动的治疗框架。该框架尝试将不同的循证运动方法和临床专业知识进行结构化整合，为您提供了临床实践中的潜在工具。
items.titleZh: 腰椎神经根病运动治疗框架的开发与内容验证
items.summaryZh: 本研究致力于开发并验证腰椎神经根病基于运动的治疗框架，旨在整合各种循证运动方法和临床专业知识。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated an exercise-based framework for lumbar radiculopathy. This framework attempts to integrate different evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise in a structured way, providing a potential tool for your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为内容验证，尚未进行临床疗效评估。
items.limitationEn: This study only focused on content validation and has not yet evaluated clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Upper-Limb Paresis Severity Is Associated With Practice Dosage During Task-Oriented Training in Subacute Stroke-An Exploratory Secondary Analysis.
items.summary: An exploratory secondary analysis of 33 individuals with subacute stroke found that upper-limb paresis severity was associated with practice dosage during task-oriented training.
items.curatedReason: 这项对亚急性卒中患者上肢任务导向训练的探索性分析发现，偏瘫严重程度与训练剂量相关。它提示在设计康复方案时，需要考虑患者基线偏瘫程度对重复训练量的影响。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者上肢偏瘫严重程度与任务导向训练剂量相关性：一项探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对33名亚急性卒中患者的探索性二次分析发现，上肢偏瘫的严重程度与任务导向训练期间的练习剂量相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis of upper-limb task-oriented training in subacute stroke found an association between paresis severity and practice dosage. It suggests that when designing rehabilitation programs, you need to consider the impact of a patient's baseline paresis level on the achievable repetition volume.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性二次分析，样本量较小（33人），且为单中心数据，结果需要进一步的验证。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory secondary analysis with a relatively small sample size (33 participants) and single-center data, so the findings require further validation.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Respiratory Function in Participants with Spinal Cord Injury of a Rehabilitation Center using Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study observed the respiratory function of 25 individuals with chronic spinal cord injury who had participated in a neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) rehabilitation program for at least three years, comparing those with tetraplegia (n=6) and paraplegia (n=16).
items.curatedReason: 本研究观察了接受神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）康复项目的脊髓损伤（SCI）患者的呼吸功能。它提供了一组长期接受NMES治疗的SCI患者呼吸功能的横断面数据，有助于了解其生理状态。
items.titleZh: 康复中心接受神经肌肉电刺激的脊髓损伤患者呼吸功能观察
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究观察了25名长期参与神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）康复项目的慢性脊髓损伤患者的呼吸功能，比较了截瘫组（n=6）和不完全截瘫组（n=16）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study observed the respiratory function of spinal cord injury (SCI) participants in a neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) rehabilitation program. It provides cross-sectional data on the respiratory function of a group of SCI patients undergoing long-term NMES, which helps in understanding their physiological status.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小（25人），可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, so it cannot establish causality, and the small sample size (25 participants) may introduce selection bias.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Impacts of ankle sprain on functional performance in under-20 soccer players: a cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study of 75 male soccer players aged 16-20 years found that ankle sprain history impacts functional performance, including ankle mobility, neuromuscular control, and dynamic balance.
items.curatedReason: 踝关节扭伤史会影响 16-20 岁男性足球运动员的功能表现，包括踝关节活动度、神经肌肉控制和动态平衡。在对年轻运动员进行运动损伤筛查和预防时，务必考虑其踝关节扭伤史，这可能预示着更高的功能缺陷风险。
items.titleZh: 踝关节扭伤对 U20 足球运动员功能表现的影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对75名16-20岁男性足球运动员的多中心横断面研究发现，踝关节扭伤史会影响功能表现，包括踝关节活动度、神经肌肉控制和动态平衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: A history of ankle sprain impacts functional performance, including ankle mobility, neuromuscular control, and dynamic balance, in 16-20 year old male soccer players. When screening and preventing sports injuries in young athletes, always consider their ankle sprain history, as it may indicate a higher risk of functional deficits.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确定踝关节扭伤与功能表现下降之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, so it cannot determine a causal relationship between ankle sprain and decreased functional performance.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Current Manual Therapy Practices in Pediatric Neurological Physiotherapy: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 61 Greek physiotherapists found that 55.7% used manual therapy in pediatric neurological physiotherapy, primarily as an adjunct, rating it most effective for joint mobility and range of motion.
items.curatedReason: 希腊物理治疗师在儿童神经康复中普遍将手法治疗作为辅助手段，且多数认为对关节活动度和ROM最有效。尽管如此，请注意，手法治疗在儿童神经康复中的证据基础尚需更多高质量研究来强化。
items.titleZh: 儿科神经物理治疗中手法治疗的现状：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对61名希腊物理治疗师的横断面调查发现，55.7%的受访者在儿科神经物理治疗中使用手法治疗，主要作为辅助干预，并认为其对关节活动度和活动范围最有效。
items.curatedReasonEn: Greek physiotherapists commonly use manual therapy as an adjunct in pediatric neurological physiotherapy, primarily for joint mobility and range of motion. However, be aware that the evidence base for manual therapy in pediatric neurorehabilitation still requires more high-quality research for robust support.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面调查，仅反映了希腊物理治疗师的观点，可能不具普遍代表性。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional survey reflecting only the perspectives of Greek physiotherapists, which may not be generally representative.

items.title: Navigating the Winding Roads of Payer Rules, Coding Modifiers, and Billing Requirements
items.summary: This article discusses the complexities of navigating payer rules, coding modifiers, and billing requirements in physical therapy practice.
items.curatedReason: WebPT 的这篇博客提醒我们，物理治疗实践中的支付方规则、编码修饰符和账单要求复杂多变。你需要持续关注这些细节，以确保诊所的合规性和财务健康，避免不必要的损失。
items.titleZh: 2026年8月12日：解读支付方规则、编码修饰符和账单要求的复杂之路
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了物理治疗实践中支付方规则、编码修饰符和账单要求等方面的复杂性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT blog post highlights the complexity of payer rules, coding modifiers, and billing requirements in physical therapy practice. You must continuously monitor these details to ensure your clinic's compliance and financial health, avoiding unnecessary losses.

items.title: Variable kinetic constraints in robotic assistance enhance learning of a complex motor skill
items.summary: This study demonstrated that variable kinetic constraints in robotic assistance enhance the learning of a complex motor skill, suggesting a potential improvement over traditional kinematic-based assistance.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，机器人辅助中的可变动力学约束能增强复杂运动技能的学习。它为康复机器人技术的发展提供了新的方向，提示您在实践中可以考虑结合动力学反馈的机器人辅助训练。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助中的可变动力学约束增强复杂运动技能学习
items.summaryZh: 这项研究表明，机器人辅助中的可变动力学约束能增强复杂运动技能的学习，提示其可能优于传统的基于运动学辅助。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that variable kinetic constraints in robotic assistance enhance the learning of complex motor skills. It offers new directions for the development of rehabilitation robotics, suggesting you might consider robot-assisted training incorporating kinetic feedback in your practice.
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康人，结果在神经功能受损患者中的适用性需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved healthy participants, and the applicability of the results to patients with neurological impairments requires further validation.

items.title: Anterior cruciate ligament rupture during a cognitively demanding change-of-direction task in football: biomechanical insights from a laboratory injury
items.summary: This case report describes an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) rupture in a football player during a cognitively demanding change-of-direction task in a laboratory setting, offering biomechanical insights into injury mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这例足球运动员在认知挑战性变向任务中发生 ACL 撕裂，提示我们 ACL 损伤风险不仅仅是生物力学问题。在 ACL 损伤预防方案中，需更加重视高认知负荷下的决策和动作控制训练。
items.titleZh: 足球运动中认知要求较高的变向任务导致前交叉韧带撕裂：实验室损伤的生物力学洞察
items.summaryZh: 本案例报告描述了一名足球运动员在实验室环境中执行认知要求较高的变向任务时发生前交叉韧带（ACL）撕裂的情况，为损伤机制提供了生物力学方面的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case of an ACL rupture in a football player during a cognitively demanding change-of-direction task suggests that ACL injury risk isn't just a biomechanical issue. In ACL prevention programs, we need to place greater emphasis on decision-making and motor control training under high cognitive load.
items.limitation: 这是一个单一案例报告，结果不具普遍性，不能直接外推到其他运动员或场景。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, so the results are not generalizable and cannot be directly extrapolated to other athletes or scenarios.

items.title: Attrition in a telehealth caregiver‐mediated behavioral intervention for children with tuberous sclerosis complex: A mixed‐methods study
items.summary: A mixed-methods study examined attrition in a telehealth caregiver-mediated behavioral intervention for young children with tuberous sclerosis complex, identifying barriers to participation among 59 families.
items.curatedReason: 在为结节性硬化症儿童设计远程医疗干预时，你必须充分考虑家庭的依从性问题。这项研究揭示了 59 个家庭退出的具体障碍，提示我们需要在方案设计中更人性化、更灵活，以提高服务完成率。
items.titleZh: 结节性硬化症儿童远程医疗看护人介导行为干预的依从性：一项混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法研究调查了结节性硬化症儿童远程医疗看护人介导行为干预的依从性，识别了59个家庭参与该干预的障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: When designing telehealth interventions for children with tuberous sclerosis complex, you must thoroughly consider family adherence. This study revealed specific barriers to attrition among 59 families, suggesting we need to be more empathetic and flexible in program design to improve service completion rates.
items.limitation: 这项研究主要侧重于依从性，未深入评估远程干预本身的临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focused on attrition and did not deeply assess the clinical efficacy of the telehealth intervention itself.

items.title: Physiotherapy Research International Call for Papers AI Applications in Physiotherapy
items.summary: Physiotherapy Research International has issued a call for papers on AI applications in physiotherapy, highlighting the rapid transformation of healthcare by AI technologies in clinical decision-making, rehabilitation delivery, and movement analysis.
items.curatedReason: 《国际物理治疗研究》的这份征稿通知探讨了人工智能在物理治疗中的应用。它表明 AI 技术正加速融入临床决策、康复交付和运动分析，提示您需关注这一领域的发展及其安全、有效和伦理整合。
items.titleZh: 《国际物理治疗研究》征稿：人工智能在物理治疗中的应用
items.summaryZh: 《国际物理治疗研究》发布了关于人工智能在物理治疗中应用的征稿通知，强调人工智能技术正在临床决策、康复交付和运动分析方面迅速改变医疗保健。
items.curatedReasonEn: This call for papers from "Physiotherapy Research International" discusses AI applications in physiotherapy. It indicates that AI technologies are rapidly integrating into clinical decision-making, rehabilitation delivery, and movement analysis, suggesting you pay attention to developments in this field and its safe, effective, and ethical integration.

items.title: Relationship Between Physiological Mirror Activity and Corticomuscular Coherence During a Finger Dexterity Task Among Healthy Young and Older Adults
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated the relationship between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence during a left-hand finger dexterity task in 31 young and 24 older right-handed adults.
items.curatedReason: 生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性在手指灵巧任务中与年龄相关。这提示我们在康复策略中可能需要针对老年人不同的神经生理机制进行调整，以优化运动学习和功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻和老年人手指灵巧任务中生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性之间的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了31名年轻右撇子成人和24名老年右撇子成人在左手手指灵巧任务中，生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性之间的关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence during finger dexterity tasks are age-related. This suggests that rehabilitation strategies for older adults may need to be adjusted to their distinct neurophysiological mechanisms to optimize motor learning and functional recovery.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法揭示生理镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性之间随时间的动态变化或因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, which cannot reveal dynamic changes over time or causal relationships between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence.

items.title: Evidence-Based Physical Therapy for the Pelvic Floor
items.summary: This book, "Evidence-Based Physical Therapy for the Pelvic Floor," published in 2015, aligns scientific research with clinical practice, offering detailed treatment strategies and innovative practice guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 这本书提供了盆底物理治疗的循证实践指导。尽管出版年份较早，它仍能为您在盆底功能障碍领域的临床实践提供基础性的、经过科学研究支持的策略。
items.titleZh: 盆底肌的循证物理治疗
items.summaryZh: 这本2015年出版的《盆底肌的循证物理治疗》将科学研究与临床实践相结合，提供了详细的治疗策略和创新的实践指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This book offers evidence-based practice guidelines for pelvic floor physical therapy. Although published earlier, it can still provide foundational, scientifically supported strategies for your clinical practice in pelvic floor dysfunction.
items.limitation: 这是一本2015年出版的书籍，内容可能未能涵盖最新的研究进展和指南。
items.limitationEn: This book was published in 2015, and its content may not cover the latest research developments and guidelines.

items.title: Longitudinal changes in serum taurine following acute traumatic spinal cord injury: a prospective pilot study of diagnostic performance and functional recovery
items.summary: A prospective pilot study investigated the longitudinal changes in serum taurine following acute traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) and its association with diagnostic performance and functional recovery.
items.curatedReason: 急性创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）后血清牛磺酸水平的变化，可能与功能恢复存在关联，但目前只是初步观察研究。这个生物标志物距离临床应用还很远，切勿过早解读或应用于患者评估。
items.titleZh: 急性创伤性脊髓损伤后血清牛磺酸的纵向变化：一项诊断性能和功能恢复的前瞻性初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性初步研究调查了急性创伤性脊髓损伤（SCI）后血清牛磺酸的纵向变化及其与诊断性能和功能恢复的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Changes in serum taurine levels after acute traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) might be associated with functional recovery, but this is merely a preliminary observational study. This biomarker is far from clinical application; do not prematurely interpret or apply it to patient assessments.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步研究，需要更大规模和更长的随访期来验证结果。
items.limitationEn: This was a pilot study, and larger scale with longer follow-up is needed to validate the results.

items.title: Sacroiliac Joint Dysfunction and Associated Disability in the Immediate Postpartum Period: A Cross-Sectional Analysis for Clinical Screening and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A descriptive cross-sectional study in Sialkot, Pakistan, involving 300 postpartum women aged 20-40 years, found a high prevalence of sacroiliac joint pain and associated disability in the immediate postpartum period.
items.curatedReason: 本项横断面研究揭示了产后骶髂关节疼痛在巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特地区发病率较高，且与功能障碍存在关联。但鉴于其观察性设计，在指导临床实践时，仍需更高级别的证据来支持干预措施的有效性。
items.titleZh: 产后即刻骶髂关节功能障碍与相关残疾：一项临床筛查与康复的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特对 300 名 20-40 岁产后女性进行的横断面研究发现，产后即刻骶髂关节疼痛患病率较高，且与功能障碍相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study reveals a high prevalence of postpartum sacroiliac joint pain and its association with disability in Sialkot, Pakistan. However, given its observational design, higher-level evidence is still needed to support the effectiveness of interventions in guiding clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，且数据来自单一地区，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and its single-region data limits generalizability.

items.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An open-label randomized controlled trial with 45 completers found that adding 3 months of tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy in Parkinson's disease patients resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，对于帕金森病患者，在设备辅助治疗（DAT）基础上增加定制化初级康复能更好地维持运动技能。将康复早期整合到 DAT 路径中是值得考虑的。尽管样本量不算大，但运动技能的维持结果提供了重要的临床方向。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病设备辅助治疗启动后的康复结局：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对帕金森病患者的随机对照试验显示，在设备辅助治疗基础上增加 3 个月的定制化初级康复，能在 6 和 12 个月时更好地维持患者的运动技能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that adding tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy (DAT) in Parkinson's disease patients can better maintain motor skills. Integrating rehabilitation early into the DAT pathway is a worthwhile consideration. Although the sample size is moderate, the motor skill maintenance outcome provides an important clinical direction.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（45 名完成者），且部分次要结局未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (45 completers) and not all secondary outcomes showed significant improvement.

items.title: Association Between Danish Guideline Treatments for Breast Cancer and Physiotherapy-Relevant Late Effects: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study from Denmark found associations between specific guideline treatments for breast cancer and the risk of physiotherapy-relevant late effects, including shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue, 3-7 years postoperatively.
items.curatedReason: 这份丹麦全国性队列研究提示，特定的乳腺癌治疗方案与术后3-7年出现肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿和疲劳等物理治疗相关晚期并发症的风险有关。这意味着在术后早期，你应密切关注那些接受了高风险治疗方案的患者，并考虑预防性干预。
items.titleZh: 丹麦乳腺癌指南治疗方案与物理治疗相关晚期并发症的关联：一项全国性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项丹麦全国性队列研究评估了乳腺癌指南治疗方案与术后 3-7 年物理治疗相关晚期并发症（如肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿、疲劳）风险的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Danish nationwide cohort study suggests specific breast cancer treatments are associated with a higher risk of late effects like shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue 3-7 years postoperatively. This implies you should closely monitor patients receiving these higher-risk treatments in the early post-op phase and consider proactive interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且结局为患者自报，存在潜在混杂因素和回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study used patient self-reported outcomes, introducing potential confounders and recall bias.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Pregnancy-Related Musculoskeletal Pain: Current Management, Influence on Biopsychosocial Health, and Patient-Reported Satisfaction With Care.
items.summary: An international internet survey of 671 women found that musculoskeletal pain is common during pregnancy, but physical therapy referral rates are unknown, and effective pain management correlates with higher satisfaction with prenatal care.
items.curatedReason: 孕期肌骨疼痛极其常见，这份国际调查显示，有效处理疼痛能显著提升孕妇对产前护理的满意度。尽管具体转诊物理治疗的数据仍缺失，这强烈提示我们应主动筛查孕妇疼痛并及时介入。
items.titleZh: 孕期肌骨疼痛：当前管理、对生物心理社会健康的影响及患者护理满意度报告
items.summaryZh: 一项对来自六大洲 671 名女性的国际线上调查显示，孕期肌骨疼痛普遍存在，但物理治疗转诊率不明，且有效的疼痛管理与产前护理满意度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Musculoskeletal pain is very common during pregnancy, and this international survey indicates that effective pain management significantly boosts satisfaction with prenatal care. While specific PT referral rates remain unknown, this strongly suggests we proactively screen pregnant patients for pain and intervene promptly.
items.limitation: 本研究为线上调查，存在回顾偏倚和自我报告偏差，且未评估具体干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This online survey is subject to recall and self-report biases and did not evaluate the efficacy of specific interventions.

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: A case report describes the rehabilitation and accelerated return-to-competition process for a 22-year-old elite international sprinter who sustained a full-thickness tear of the external, internal, and transversus abdominis muscles.
items.curatedReason: 这是一个关于精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂的个案报道，描述了其加速重返赛场的康复过程。这为你处理罕见运动损伤和制定高水平运动员重返赛场策略提供了个案经验，但由于是单一个案，不应直接泛化为临床指南。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场的案例报告：数据支持
items.summaryZh: 一份案例报告描述了一名 22 岁精英国际短跑运动员在腹外斜肌、腹内斜肌和腹横肌全层撕裂后，通过康复训练加速重返赛场的详细过程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report details the accelerated return-to-competition of an elite sprinter with a full-thickness abdominal wall tear. While offering insights into rare sports injuries and high-level return-to-sport strategies, its single-case nature prevents direct generalization to clinical guidelines.
items.limitation: 本研究为单一个案报告，外推性差，不代表普遍情况或可复制的干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with limited generalizability, not representative of common outcomes or reproducible intervention effects.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Telerehabilitation before and after lumbar spine surgery: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped existing evidence on telerehabilitation interventions for patients undergoing lumbar spine surgery, highlighting intervention characteristics and identifying evidence gaps due to a lack of standardized protocols.
items.curatedReason: 目前，腰椎术后远程康复尚无标准化方案。这份范围综述虽梳理了现有干预模式，但更多是揭示了该领域的证据空白，别指望能直接从中提取成熟的临床路径。
items.titleZh: 腰椎术前术后的远程康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统梳理了腰椎手术患者远程康复干预的现有证据，重点关注干预特征，并指出现有研究在标准化方案上的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized protocols for telerehabilitation in lumbar spine surgery are still missing. While this scoping review maps existing interventions, it primarily highlights current evidence gaps; don't expect to find ready-to-implement clinical pathways here.
items.limitation: 本综述识别了研究空白，但未对现有干预的有效性进行系统评价或荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: This review identified research gaps but did not systematically evaluate or meta-analyze the effectiveness of existing interventions.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Preliminary effects of myofascial release on chest mobility and trunk impairmentin patients with chronic stroke: a pilotRandomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot RCT (n=20) investigated the preliminary effects of myofascial release (MFR) on chest mobility and trunk impairment in chronic stroke patients, comparing MFR plus inspiratory muscle training (IMT) to chest stretching, diaphragmatic breathing, and IMT over 8 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 筋膜松弛术在慢性卒中患者胸部活动度和躯干功能障碍上的初步效果是积极的。这是个小样本试点研究，提示了潜在的增益，但在常规应用前还需等待大规模 RCT 验证。
items.titleZh: 筋膜松弛术对慢性卒中患者胸部活动度和躯干功能障碍的初步效果：一项随机对照试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 20 名慢性卒中患者的试点 RCT 显示，筋膜松弛术（MFR）联合呼吸肌训练（IMT）与传统胸部牵伸、膈式呼吸及 IMT 相比，在改善胸部活动度和躯干功能障碍方面可能具有积极效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Myofascial release shows positive preliminary effects on chest mobility and trunk impairment in chronic stroke patients. This small pilot study suggests potential benefits, but larger RCTs are needed before routine clinical application.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本试点 RCT (n=20)，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot RCT (n=20), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Managing Patients With Hypermobility Disorders: They've Seen You, but Have You Seen Them?
items.summary: This editorial highlights the challenges physical therapists face in managing hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS), proposing a structured approach to care amidst limited high-quality randomized trials but emerging consensus.
items.curatedReason: 针对超活动度障碍（HSD/hEDS）患者，这份述评提供了实用的管理框架。在 RCT 证据有限的情况下，它能帮助你系统化评估，避免碎片化治疗。
items.titleZh: 管理超活动度障碍患者：你了解他们，他们也需要被你理解吗？
items.summaryZh: 针对物理治疗师在管理超活动度障碍（HSD）和超活动性埃勒斯-丹洛斯综合征（hEDS）患者时面临的挑战，本述评提出了一种结构化的治疗方法，以应对高质量随机试验有限但共识不断涌现的局面。
items.curatedReasonEn: With high-quality RCT evidence for hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD/hEDS) still largely absent, this editorial offers a practical management framework. Use it to structure your approach and avoid fragmented care, but recognize it reflects expert consensus, not strong evidence.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: External validation of the minimal important change in the Berg Balance Scale scores of patients hospitalized for subacute stroke.
items.summary: This longitudinal study externally validated minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in 286 patients hospitalized for subacute stroke, assessing 2-, 5-, and 9-point thresholds in overall and walking-ability subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究外部验证了亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表（BBS）的最小重要变化（MIC）值，尤其细分了步行能力亚组。这能让你更精准地解读 BBS 评分变化，评估患者的功能改善。
items.titleZh: 住院亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表评分最小重要变化值的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向研究对286名住院亚急性卒中患者的 Berg 平衡量表（BBS）评分的最小重要变化（MIC）值进行了外部验证，评估了在整体队列和步行能力亚组中 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study externally validates the minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in subacute stroke patients, with subgroups based on walking ability. This allows you to interpret BBS score changes more precisely and assess functional improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，仅在特定康复单元进行，可能存在选择偏倚和外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This study has an observational design and was conducted in a specific rehabilitation unit, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: This study externally validated a machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke (ARAT scores) using an independent Danish prospective cohort, following development on a multicenter Dutch cohort of first-ever ischemic stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 这个模型在独立丹麦队列中的外部验证，意味着其对卒中后6个月上肢功能的预测能力具备初步的泛化性。我们离利用机器学习辅助临床决策又近了一步，但请注意，在常规临床应用前仍需更多高质量验证。
items.titleZh: 中风后上肢恢复早期预测机器学习模型的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 本研究外部验证了一个机器学习模型，该模型用于预测中风后 6 个月上肢能力（通过 ARAT 评分衡量），验证队列为一个独立的丹麦前瞻性队列，此前该模型在荷兰的多中心首次缺血性中风患者队列中开发。
items.curatedReasonEn: This model's external validation in an independent Danish cohort suggests its predictive ability for 6-month upper-limb function post-stroke has initial generalizability. We're closer to leveraging machine learning for clinical decision support, but remember, more high-quality validation is needed before routine clinical adoption.
items.limitation: 验证队列包含了缺血性和出血性中风患者，但模型是在荷兰的首次缺血性中风队列中开发的，可能影响对其他类型中风的泛化能力。
items.limitationEn: The validation cohort included both ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke patients, but the model was developed in a Dutch cohort of first-ever ischemic strokes, which might affect generalizability to other stroke types.

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.
items.summary: This call to action encourages musculoskeletal physical therapists, organizations, and systems to engage in multisector efforts to improve care and outcomes for Indigenous Peoples in clinical practice, research, and education.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论呼吁物理治疗师在临床、研究和教育中关注原住民的骨骼肌肉健康，并作为盟友和倡导者发挥作用。这是建立更具包容性和公平的物理治疗实践的重要一步，值得思考和借鉴。
items.titleZh: 携手前行。第六部分：为原住民群体改革肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗——一项行动呼吁
items.summaryZh: 这项行动呼吁鼓励肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统参与多部门合作，以改善原住民群体的临床实践、研究和教育中的护理和结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary calls on physical therapists to prioritize Indigenous musculoskeletal health in clinical practice, research, and education, acting as allies and advocates. It's a crucial step towards more inclusive and equitable physical therapy practices, warranting reflection and adoption.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) in chronic ischemic stroke patients found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，在慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢康复中，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）结合机器人疗法并未显示出额外的显著益处。这意味着对于这类患者，单纯的机器人疗法可能已经足够，没必要盲目叠加脑刺激技术。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激对慢性缺血性卒中后上肢机器人康复的附加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 36 例慢性缺血性卒中上肢障碍患者的随机、双盲、假对照试验发现，在机器人治疗基础上增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS），并未对上肢运动和功能恢复带来额外益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that adding rTMS or tDCS to robotic therapy did not provide significant additional benefits for upper extremity recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. This suggests that robotic therapy alone might be sufficient for these patients, without the need to indiscriminately combine brain stimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=36），且是单中心试验，结果需更多大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (N=36) and was a single-center trial, so results require validation from larger studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary highlights that while exercise is a ubiquitous recommendation in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, there is a lack of confidence, consistency, and clarity in how prescription decisions are made and communicated. It advocates for emphasizing longitudinal reasoning linking patient assessment to prescription and modification.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方是 PT 最核心的技能，但目前缺乏标准化语言和系统性方法论。这篇文章提醒你，与其关注处方表开了什么，不如深挖评估、进展和调整的纵向推理，这才是提升临床实践的关键。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗最重要的、但标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，运动处方在骨骼肌肉物理治疗中普遍存在，但处方决策和沟通的信心、一致性和清晰度有限。文章强调应侧重于将患者评估与处方、进展和修改联系起来的纵向推理，而非仅仅关注处方输出。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prescription is a core PT skill, yet it lacks standardized language and systematic methodology. This article reminds you that focusing on longitudinal reasoning from assessment to progression and modification, rather than just the prescription outputs, is key to enhancing clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评，不涉及实证研究设计。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary and does not involve empirical research design.

items.title: One-year Health Care Utilization Following Physical Therapist Evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found that physical therapist evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department for musculoskeletal pain was associated with decreased healthcare utilization within the ED, but showed no significant association with overall 1-year musculoskeletal healthcare utilization.
items.curatedReason: 急诊物理治疗师（EDPT）介入后，退伍军人因肌肉骨骼疼痛的医疗利用率在 ED 内有所下降，但一年内的整体医疗利用率差异不显著。这提示 EDPT 仍能优化急诊流程，但要降低长期总利用率，可能还需要更全面的多学科策略。
items.titleZh: 退伍军人事务部急诊科物理治疗师评估后一年内的医疗利用情况
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究显示，退伍军人事务部急诊科对肌肉骨骼疼痛患者进行物理治疗师评估后，急诊科内部的医疗利用率有所下降，但与一年内整体肌肉骨骼医疗利用率无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: After Emergency Department Physical Therapist (EDPT) intervention, healthcare utilization for musculoskeletal pain decreased within the ED for veterans, but no significant difference was observed in overall 1-year healthcare utilization. This suggests EDPTs can optimize ED processes, but reducing long-term total utilization may require more comprehensive, multidisciplinary strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且仅限于单一退伍军人健康管理局急诊科，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study conducted at a single Veterans Health Administration ED, limiting the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Acute Effects of Varying Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation Amplitude on Quadriceps Isometric Torque and Muscle Thickness in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Split-Limb Trial.
items.summary: A randomized split-limb trial in healthy young adults (N unspecified) found that increasing self-reported tolerated neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) amplitude did not enhance acute quadriceps isometric torque or muscle thickness.
items.curatedReason: 关于神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）剂量学，该研究发现，在健康年轻人中，自报可耐受振幅的增加并不能显著增强急性股四头肌等长扭矩或肌肉厚度。这意味着高强度并非总是带来更优的急性生理反应，为临床设定 NMES 参数提供了更精细的考量。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻人中不同神经肌肉电刺激振幅对股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度的急性影响：一项随机分肢试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康年轻人的随机分肢试验发现，增加自报可耐受的神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）振幅，并未能增强股四头肌的急性等长扭矩和肌肉厚度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Regarding neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) dosimetry, this study found that increasing self-reported tolerated amplitude did not significantly enhance acute quadriceps isometric torque or muscle thickness in healthy young adults. This suggests that higher intensity does not always yield superior acute physiological responses, offering a more nuanced consideration for clinical NMES parameter setting.
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康年轻人，结果外推到临床患者群体时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study involved healthy young adults; results should be applied cautiously when extrapolating to clinical patient populations.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association has released a 2026 revision of its clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, updating the 2020 version based on a systematic review of current literature and formulating 20 recommendations.
items.curatedReason: PTA 发布了全膝关节置换（TKA）物理治疗管理指南的 2026 年修订版，这是一线指南。立即查阅并将其整合进你的 TKA 术后康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会发布了其全膝关节置换（TKA）物理治疗管理临床实践指南的 2026 年修订版，该指南基于系统综述更新了 2020 年版本，并提出了 20 条建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA has released its 2026 revision of the clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This is a front-line guideline. Review it immediately and integrate its recommendations into your TKA post-op rehabilitation protocols.

items.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT of 56 adults with chronic vestibular dizziness found that 8 weeks of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability compared to sham rTMS plus VR.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性前庭性眩晕，rTMS 结合前庭康复（VR）显示出显著的改善效果。如果你的诊所有 rTMS 设备，可以作为慢性前庭功能障碍患者的增效治疗手段。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激治疗成人慢性前庭性眩晕的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性：一项双盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 56 名慢性前庭性眩晕成年患者的双盲随机对照试验显示，为期 8 周的重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合前庭康复（VR）显著改善了眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性，优于假 rTMS 结合 VR。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, rTMS combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) shows significant improvement. If your clinic has rTMS equipment, consider it as an augmentative treatment for patients with chronic vestibular dysfunction.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明随机分组的详细过程及偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: The study did not elaborate on the detailed randomization process and potential bias risks.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of a Virtual Reality-Based Balance Training Program on Clinical Outcomes and Cortical Oscillatory Activity: A Combined Behavioral and EEG Study.
items.summary: A single-group repeated-measures study of 28 subacute stroke survivors found that 12 sessions of VR-based balance training over 4 weeks improved clinical mobility outcomes, including Berg Balance Scale and Timed Up and Go scores.
items.curatedReason: 短期的 VR 平衡训练似乎能在卒中亚急性期患者中改善平衡和运动功能。可以考虑将其作为常规康复的补充手段。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实平衡训练对卒中患者临床结局和皮层振荡活动的影响：一项行为与脑电图结合研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 28 名亚急性期卒中幸存者的单组重复测量研究显示，为期 4 周的 12 次虚拟现实平衡训练课程改善了伯格平衡量表（BBS）和计时起立行走（TUG）测试等临床运动结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Short-term VR balance training appears to improve balance and motor function in subacute stroke survivors. Consider integrating it as a supplemental intervention in your rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性单组重复测量研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective single-group repeated-measures study without a control group, so it cannot rule out placebo effects or natural recovery.
